quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

activation.description: Stop, stand or park in marked passenger curb zone during effective signed hours
activation.source_clause: shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time ... in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations ... are effective

obligation.description: Refrain from stopping, standing or parking except for expeditious passenger loading or unloading
obligation.source_clause: shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers

exceptions.description: Expeditious loading or unloading of passengers
exceptions.source_clause: except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers

timing.description: Effective zone hours from original sign and measured civil time; no statutory minimum stop duration

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: place marked as a passenger curb loading zone
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authored curb and sign readback does not establish legal regulatory authority.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective
judgment_calls_needed.note: The source sign schedule and civil clock are measured; legal effect requires original source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: expeditious loading or unloading of passengers
judgment_calls_needed.note: Door commands and a pedestrian near the vehicle do not establish actual exchange or expeditiousness.
